name: JAVA 佳沃 Vittoria 7170 closed-wheel build
why_interesting: A current regional Vittoria Air R7170 page matches the visible 105 Di2 and 88 mm front / rear disc-wheel configuration, while the two retained mainland prices still require separate SKU resolution.

facts.frame_material: Full-carbon frame, fork, hybrid handlebar and seatpost on the current Chilean reference build
facts.frame_construction: Seat-tube-eliminated aero road/triathlon frame with thru axles and a multi-position hybrid carbon cockpit; exact lay-up and molding process are not published
facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 Di2 R7170 electronic 2x12 / 24-speed, 50/34T crank and Shimano 105 11-34T cassette with hydraulic disc brakes
facts.complete_weight_basis: Current Chilean complete-bike reference-build claim; size, pedals, accessories and measurement method are not stated
facts.wheels: Current Chilean reference build: DECAF carbon 88 mm front wheel and carbon rear disc wheel with Center Lock rotors
facts.tires: Continental 700x28C fitted on the current Chilean reference build; this is not a published maximum
facts.stiffness_evidence: No exact-model numeric stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent frame-stiffness assessment was found across the 50-area sweep

missing: Separate exact groupset, wheelset, year, and promotion identities
A separate variant and price record for each proven trim
Maximum tire clearance, meaningful stiffness evidence, complete-weight basis, current checkout conditions and domestic warranty route
source_note: The regional reference build matches the retained card's named R7170 and closed-wheel configuration, but it is not assigned to either mainland price observation. Its 9.2 kg claim lacks size and equipment basis; fitted 28C tires do not establish maximum clearance.
